notes: Employment demand uses SHRUG's 2013 Economic Census city-wide workplace total for Hyderabad, redistributed using real 2011 Census GHMC ward-level worker counts. Only 99 of GHMC's ~144 wards had a matching Census figure — the other ~45 are mostly outer wards absorbed from Ranga Reddy district in 2007 that the 2011 Census never separately tabulated at GHMC ward level. For wards missing a Census figure, we substitute a modeled proxy weight built from that ward's own OSM landuse data, clearly distinguished from the real Census-derived weights; 27 of the 46 gap wards got a usable proxy, and 19 remain a documented residual limit with no landuse signal to draw on either. Jobs placed within wards via OSM building footprints by type; population and commute data follow the standard project pipeline.
